title: Petra and the Playlist
author: Coral Fairweather
blurb: Coral Sandoval, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
